claim: FR-014 and the Field Ownership table require all four record timepoints (创建/传递/确认/实施) on every decision record (「四个时点必须齐全」) and M-01 turns red on any missing timepoint, but decisions from the non-transmitting producers (P-02 requirements, P-03 plan, P-04 checkpoint, P-05 analyze, P-08 goal/anchor/team) are never dispatched to a subagent and never produce an implementation receipt, so 传递/确认/实施 events cannot exist; SC-005 then requires rebuilding 「FR-014 的全部字段」 for a fixture set spanning exactly requirements/plan/checkpoint/run report carriers. No absent/n-a representation or conditional wording is defined for the three event timepoints, so either every such legitimate record reds M-01 or an undefined form must be invented.

claim: Two machine-decidable obligations sit outside every M rule. (a) FR-019 requires the subagent return to carry 决策确认 plus implementation_receipt, and SC-006 claims both are covered by 「M-05 绿」, but M-05's red conditions cover only receipt presence and `decision_id` resolvability, and M-07 covers only the three chain segments (record/dispatch/receipt); confirmation presence is never asserted. (b) `transmission_status` and the implementation-status dimension each carry a closed value domain declared on the owner page, and A-9 classifies 「闭集取值」 as machine-decidable, yet no M rule validates their values (M-01 reds only on missing fields, class value, timestamp shape).
propagation_surface: M-05/M-07 guard coverage; decision-definitions.md value domains; SC-006 assertion

claim: The closed Decision Producer Inventory has two amendment vehicles with no precedence: SC-001 measures the declaration set against 「本规格 § Decision Producer Inventory」, while A-5 and the inventory footer allow extensions to land in the owner page's 「同名表」 instead, and FR-001's enumeration of owner-page-owned surfaces does not include the inventory. Constitution XIV requires exactly one authoritative definition point, so an extension recorded only in the owner page leaves SC-001's declaration set stale and the containment claim silently false.
